evidence.title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles

summary: Researchers examined the effect of AI tutoring tools on participants solving logic puzzles, finding that while AI offers immediate feedback, it can also diminish learners' independent problem‑solving abilities. The findings urge designers to balance AI support with opportunities for autonomous reasoning to foster deeper skill acquisition.
title: AI Assistance Impacts Human Skill Development in Logic Puzzle Learning, Study Shows
